eq-head.title: Your account against SPY
eq-head.body: Your Alpaca account over the past year, time weighted so deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains, beside SPY over the same days. Read from Alpaca, read only.

act-head.title: Every account event
act-head.body: Everything that happened on the account, newest first: trades, cash moves, dividends and interest. The buttons above the table filter by type. Read from Alpaca's own records.

gl-head.title: Realized gain or loss
gl-head.body: Closed positions matched first in, first out, by trade date and before fees: the total, this year, lots closed, lots that gained and the average. For taxes, your broker's 1099 is the record.

alloc-head.title: Allocation
alloc-head.body: What the account holds now, by asset class and then name by name: shares, average entry, market value, gain or loss not yet taken, and each one's weight.

stmt-head.title: Monthly statements
stmt-head.body: One month on the account, its activity and holdings, read from your broker. Pick the month, then print it or save it as a PDF. It is a summary, not an official brokerage statement.
